title: Mystic Cat Guardian
description: A bald woman with purple skin and intricate glowing golden tattoos cradles a white cat with green eyes on her shoulder. She has long flowing red hair and is surrounded by a swirling dark vortex containing faint ghostly faces, ruined gothic structures and a crescent moon.
prompt: A bald purple-skinned woman with glowing golden spiral tattoos on her head and arms holds a mystical white cat with bright green eyes on her shoulder. She has long vibrant red hair in a braid, green eyes, and wears a red cloak. They are floating in a swirling dark vortex of night sky with ghostly faces, ruined gothic buildings, and a crescent moon in the background, surreal fantasy style, intricate details, atmospheric lighting
